name: SecretProviderSet
description:
Sets a secret value in a configured Secret Provider. The value type is automatically detected and stored appropriately as a string, boolean, or integer.
Note: Not all Secret Providers support writing. Providers that are read-only (such as environment variables) will throw an exception when attempting to set a value.
syntax: SecretProviderSet( string key, any value, string name )

params.name: key
params.description: Key to store the secret under (e.g., "database.password", "api.key")

params.name: value
params.description: The secret value to store. Can be a string, boolean, or integer.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Secret Provider to write to, as configured in .CFConfig.json.
